text:
sara-support: FYI — incoming support ticket from @jordan about Google/GitHub login failing intermittently. Says redirect comes back with missing/altered state, causing 403 from our callback.

jordan-customer: Happens on iOS webview behind their corporate proxy. Steps: click login -> redirected to provider -> provider redirects back to our /auth/callback?code=... missing state param sometimes. Only reproducible ~30% attempts.

devin-identity: Can you paste the exact redirect URL you saw?

jordan-customer: Here's one captured: `https://app.example.com/auth/callback?code=4/XYZ&scope=openid%20email` (no state). Another attempt has `state=` empty.

devin-identity: Thanks. We saw similar in logs — callback hits our endpoint but querystring gets reordered and sometimes state param truncated after `+` characters. Suspect proxy or LB normalizing `+` to space or dropping duplicate parameters.

alex-eng: On the infra side, our ingress has `strip_query_order` feature enabled in older nginx template; it collapses repeated params. Also some proxies decode `+` as space if not percent-encoded. Could be client sending space vs `+`. We should check upstream nginx access logs for the raw request line.

maya-sre: Pulling tcpdump now on staging ingress for that tenant. Also saw a Cloudflare Worker rule that rewrites `/auth/*` and uses `URL.searchParams.toString()` then forwards — that will convert `+` to space if not encoded. That matches.

devin-identity: Repro steps for support to give customer: 1) Try login in Safari non-webview 2) Ask proxy admin to ensure `+` characters in state are percent-encoded as `%2B` 3) As temporary server-side mitigation, we can accept empty state if `Referer` and session cookie match (risk tradeoff).

alex-eng: Proposed permanent fix: change callback to accept PKCE+state via POST form-callback (switch provider redirect to POST?) Not practical. Better: migrate state storage to short-lived server-side session keyed by a one-time cookie (store PKCE verifier server-side instead of embedding full state). Low-risk patch: if state missing but session cookie present, allow step.

sara-support: For now, communicate the workaround to Jordan: try non-webview or have proxy encode `+` to `%2B`. I'll send repro steps and ask for network capture.

oauth-bot: automated note: created ticket #SUP-4921 and assigned to devin-identity.

sara-support: tagging @alex-eng @maya-sre for follow-up; will update ticket when customer confirms.
